To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the pre-processing of financial account data is an important factor for the forecast capability of the ANN.
linear pre-processing on the company level is not suitable for financial statements and that linear pre-processing is more appropriate than nonlinear pre-processing.
the best results are achieved when all the financial account values are scaled either linearly (i.e. the data are scaled by using their minimum and maximum values) or linearly on yearly basis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the pre-processing of data in order to achieve the best results for auditing purposes.
the pre-processing of data when using ANNs for auditing purposes.
the pre-processing of financial data when using neural network models for auditing purposes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the pre-processing of data is an important step in the process of auditing with ANNs.
the results of the pre-processing of financial accounts are not very sensitive to the pre-processing models used.
the pre-processing of data is important when using ANNs for auditing purposes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the pre-processing of data is important for the forecast capability of the ANN model.
the best pre-processing model for auditing financial accounts is to pre-process the data on a yearly basis.

pre-processing the data is an essential part of the neural network modelling process.
